seed: A component can ask two variant questions at once, the way the variants mock's Button is Primary or Secondary AND Small, Medium or Large (ui-variants.html, #segVariant, #segSize and the .pmatrix grid). This walk drops a Button at Next defaults, opens its original, gives it a Secondary look, then adds a Size property from the Add menu and calls the new drawing's size Large. Edit Original then shows the drawings as a Variant by Size grid with the answers along its edges, one cell empty because nobody drew Default Large. On a copy the panel shows a VARIANT row and a SIZE row; Large is clicked with the pointer and shows the nearest drawing that exists, undo puts it back in one step, and Secondary then Large lands on the drawing that was drawn.

steps.note: the original of a Button asking two questions: Variant with Default and Secondary, Size with Default and Large, and the drawings as a grid with Default and Secondary down the left and Default and Large along the top
a copy of the Button: VARIANT over Default | Secondary and SIZE over Default | Large, each its own row

steps.reads: Size, already on Large, tooltip none
Variant, already on Default, tooltip none

steps.note: Large clicked on a Default copy: nobody drew Default Large, so the copy shows the nearest drawing that is Large (the faded Secondary Large) and the rows still read Default and Large

steps.reads: Variant, already on Secondary, tooltip none
Size, already on Large, tooltip none

steps.note: Secondary then Large: the drawing that was drawn
